style_prefix: Editorial brand design for Yolodex, an AI creative strategy team for DTC growth teams. Off-white paper background (#F7F4EC), near-black ink (#111111), a single marker-yellow signal colour (#FFE600) used sparingly like a highlighter. Serif display type, tight grotesk body, monospace annotations. Hairline rules, generous margins, a real column grid. Flat, printed, no gradients, no glow, no 3D, no sparkles, no purple, no stock-photo people. Looks like the research desk of a serious business newspaper, not a SaaS website.
negative: gradient, glow, neon, purple, blob, sparkles, 3D render, glassmorphism, stock photo, people at laptops, dark mode, cluttered, low contrast, blurry text

Ink and paper with one yellow accent.

Homepage hero image. A single vertical Meta video-ad still (a young woman holding a supplement sachet in a kitchen, natural light, real-looking, not stock) placed on paper, surrounded by Yolodex's markup: thin ink callout lines to small monospace labels such as HOOK 0:00–0:02, FORMAT: UGC TESTIMONIAL, CLAIM: SLEEP, TALENT: FOUNDER, and one yellow tag reading WINNER · 90% OF WINNING ADS. Plenty of empty paper on the left for a headline. Flat, printed, precise.

A newspaper-style masthead org chart on paper. Below, a hairline rule, then seven bylines in a row in monospace capitals: CREATIVE ANALYST, PERFORMANCE ANALYST, INSIGHTS RESEARCHER, CREATIVE RESEARCHER, CREATIVE STRATEGIST, COPYWRITER, EXPERIMENTATION LEAD, each with a one-line description beneath in small grotesk. Ink on paper, one yellow accent.

Wide LinkedIn banner, 4:1. Paper background. Left: the lowercase wordmark 'yolodex' in a tight grotesk with a marker-yellow underline swipe. Centre-right: three small annotated ad stills with hairline callouts and mono labels. Far right in serif: 'Creative is the new targeting.' Flat editorial layout, lots of air.

Open Graph image, 1200 by 630. Paper background. Large serif headline 'Creative is the new targeting.' top left, smaller grotesk subline 'We build the creative briefs that win.' below it, one small annotated ad still bottom right with a yellow WINNER tag, lowercase 'yolodex' wordmark bottom left. Flat, printed, precise.

Brand mark study derived from the reference character (a chubby upright badger with round wire glasses, cream face, charcoal coat, cream head stripe, pink nose). Redraw only the HEAD, front-on, simplified to two flat colours (ink #111111 and paper #F7F4EC) so it reads at 16px: keep the round glasses, the cream face stripe, the small ears and the pink nose reduced to a single ink dot. Centre it on paper with a marker-yellow circle (#FFE600) behind it. No gradients, no shading, no text.

Favicon study sheet on paper. The reference badger's head, simplified, shown four times in a row at decreasing sizes (256px, 64px, 32px, 16px) to test legibility. Flat two-colour ink and paper, round glasses kept, marker-yellow circle behind each. Nothing else in the frame.
